mapper.select: SELECT id, config_key, config_value, key_version, encrypted, updated_by, updated_at FROM t_sys_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_sys_config (config_key, config_value, key_version, encrypted, updated_by) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{keyVersion}, #{encrypted}, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), key_version = VALUES(key_version), encrypted = VALUES(encrypted), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)
